reported_success.quote: Like Roelofs et al. (2010), we find a modulation by state anxiety, but in the current study this is only marginal and we do not replicate the negative correlation between heart rate and STAI.

notes: The description names social threat, anxiety and their interaction but does not uniquely distinguish the tests on the supplied page. The extracted candidate is the full-sample block × STAI interaction, retaining the outlier; target_match remains unknown. The same locator also covers block main effect with STAI (.10, p = .070), outlier-excluded interaction (.11, p = .053), and contrasts. These are separate tests and were not merged. Confidence flags indicate that the candidate values are explicitly printed, not that this candidate is certainly the intended target. No original statistics reconstructed from the replication introduction.
